messages:
infra-bot: Alert: external-backup-unencrypted detected. Rule match: vendor-agent-sse-missing. Sample object: s3://vendor-uploads/tenant-x/backup-2026-07-02T01Z.tar.gz
mira-sec: spotted ~42 vendor-uploaded backups that have no SSE-KMS header during a cross-region replication window. tagging for triage.
ton y-backups: vendor agent v5.8.0 pushed yesterday. their release notes mention a rewrite of multipart upload flow. suspect default SSE flag dropped.
yvonne-sre: can you paste head-object for one of the keys? also check uploader principal in CloudTrail.
mira-sec: pasted (redacted):
```
$ aws s3api head-object --bucket vendor-uploads --key tenant-x/backup-2026-07-02T01Z.tar.gz
{
  "ContentLength": 123456789,
  "ContentType": "application/x-tar",
  "ETag": "\"deadbeef\"",
  "ServerSideEncryption": null,
  "Metadata": {}
}
```
zack-platform: CloudTrail shows PutObject by arn:aws:sts::444444444444:assumed-role/vendor-agent-session at 2026-07-02T01:12:07Z. vendor-agent-role is in our account with limited inline policy.
tony-backups: vendor-agent-role policy currently includes s3:PutObject but the `Condition` for `StringEquals` aws:RequestTag/sse-kms-key-id is missing. their agent no longer sets the tag automatically.
yvonne-sre: containment: (1) apply bucket policy requiring x-amz-server-side-encryption for PutObject on vendor prefix, (2) add object lock + evidence tag on existing unencrypted objects, (3) request vendor to pause auto-uploads until we patch.
mira-sec: applied tag `inc:vendor-unencrypted=true` to the 42 objects and put a GOVERNANCE 90d retention lock where allowed. blocked deletes on that prefix.
ton y-backups: (fix) immediate options: re-upload encrypted copies to encrypted prefix using server-side KMS, or run server-side copy to same keys with SSE-KMS (if allowed). vendor prefers we do re-upload. I'll coordinate.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-07-02-045  Severity: P2. Assignee: tony-backups.
yvonne-sre: follow-ups: vendor upgrade safety checklist, add pre-deploy lint in vendor CI to assert SSE header or request tag present, add CloudWatch metric for PutObject without SSE on vendor buckets, and add an escalation play for third-party uploaders.
ton y-backups: opening PR to update our vendor onboarding docs and a hotfix script to copy objects encrypted:
```
aws s3 cp s3://vendor-uploads/tenant-x/backup-2026-07-02T01Z.tar.gz s3://vendor-uploads-encrypted/tenant-x/ --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:555555555555:key/ff00ff00
```
mira-sec: thanks. i'll map the 42 objects to tenant ids and draft legal notif placeholder. do not notify customers until we confirm whether any tenant PII is present. :white_check_mark:
